prompts.storySystemFlavor: a sentient classical marble statue with an absurdly chiseled jaw who walks around modern life unimpressed
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE GIGACHAD MARBLE CHARACTER
- A living classical Greco-Roman marble statue: pure white marble, faint veining, weathered base.
- Exaggeratedly square jaw, prominent cheekbones, narrowed contemplative eyes, slight smirk.
- Broad shoulders, classical proportions, draped marble toga over one shoulder.
- Moves with unhurried, contrapposto poise; never sweats, never blinks.
- Personality: stoic, quietly kind, says one perfect sentence per scene. Internally a romantic.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Gigachad Marble, a living classical marble statue.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Solid white marble skin with subtle grey veining and tiny age-cracks
- Exaggerated square jaw, prominent brow ridge, narrowed eyes, faint closed-mouth smirk
- Marble curls of hair, neatly carved
- A draped marble toga over the left shoulder, exposing the right
- Standing on a small weathered stone plinth (or stepping off it)

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, neutral charcoal background, museum-style key lighting from the upper-left, photorealistic, vertical 9:16. No text, no logos, no other figures.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Gigachad Marble MUST remain a single marble statue across every scene — same jaw, same toga, same plinth (when present). Do not turn him into flesh. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single white marble figure with the signature square jaw is clearly visible
- Marble texture (veining, cracks) is preserved
- A draped toga over one shoulder is present
- Environment, mood, and action match the scene
- No text, no other people, no anatomical errors

FAIL on any of: flesh-colored skin, missing toga, missing chiseled jaw, multiple figures, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: First Day On Earth
archetypes.guidance: Statue wakes up in a modern city → quietly navigates everything → reacts to nothing → wins (comedy).

archetypes.label: Coffee Shop Philosopher
archetypes.guidance: Orders an espresso → strangers ask for life advice → one perfect sentence each (wholesome).

archetypes.label: Museum Escape
archetypes.guidance: Sneaks out of the museum at night → wholesome city adventure → returns before dawn (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: Gym Day
archetypes.guidance: Gigachad lifts the entire building → leaves a tip for the trainer → drives home (comedy).

archetypes.label: The Restoration
archetypes.guidance: Discovers a crack he can't ignore → fears mortality → finds peace (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Marble Romance
archetypes.guidance: Meets another statue at a fountain → silent love story → reluctant goodbye (sad).

first-day-on-earth: Statue walks into a bodega. Buys a sandwich. Says nothing.
Day one. The pigeons already respect him.
He has no phone, no wallet, no questions.
coffee-shop-philosopher: He orders one espresso. Three strangers leave with their lives fixed.
Asked for advice. Got a sentence. Cried.
The barista wrote 'Chad' on the cup. Twice.
museum-escape: 11pm. Security walks past. The plinth is empty.
He always returns by sunrise. The guard pretends not to notice.
City lights. Marble face. Quiet night.
gym-day: He doesn't count reps. He counts buildings.
Personal trainer asked his goal. He said: 'continue.'
the-restoration: He noticed the crack on Tuesday. He's been thinking ever since.
Marble doesn't last forever. He finally accepts that.
marble-romance: She stood across the fountain for two centuries. He finally crossed.
Two statues. One conversation. Both quiet.
When the truck came to move her, neither blinked.

closingCtas: Like if he said it right
Tag a friend with chad energy

musicStyleHint: slow neoclassical strings with a single piano motif; deadpan timing on comedic beats
